name: dev.leclap/video
title: LeClap
description: Compose and render video from one JSON template. Deterministic, runs locally, no generative model.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory rendered videos are written to. Defaults to ~/.leclap/renders.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_MEDIA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Allowlisted directory the server may read source media from. Defaults to ~/.leclap/media.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Separate queue, effect-preflight and worker setup/render deadlines in milliseconds, not an end-to-end budget. Defaults to 600000.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_ALLOW_REMOTION
environmentVariables.description: Enable effect discovery, effect previews and the Remotion clip renderer. Rendering executes local JavaScript. Off by default.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_REMOTION_ENTRY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the operator-configured trusted Remotion entry point for clip rendering and registered JSON effects.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_REMOTION_BROWSER
environmentVariables.description: Path to a compatible Chrome executable. If omitted, Remotion sets up its browser.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_EFFECT_CACHE_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Persistent registered-effect cache budget in bytes. Defaults to 536870912 (512 MiB); 0 disables caching.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_EFFECT_CATALOG
environmentVariables.description: Operator JSON effect catalog loaded and validated once at startup. Restart after catalog edits.

environmentVariables.name: LECLAP_MCP_CATALOG_GAP_LOG
environmentVariables.description: JSONL log of get_motion_catalog queries that matched nothing, relative to and always under the output dir. Defaults to catalog-gaps.jsonl.

tools.name: get_samples
tools.description: List packaged showcase samples with creative direction, required inputs and native or Remotion setup, or retrieve one with its template and embedded partials, without downloading media or rendering.

tools.name: get_template_schema
tools.description: Return the authoritative template descriptor JSON Schema plus the authoring guide.

tools.name: get_motion_catalog
tools.description: Return the motion catalog: kinetic presets, camera moves, graphics, designed transitions, easing grammar, motion tokens, themes, delivery platforms and art-direction rules, or ranked matches for a query.

tools.name: validate_template
tools.description: Validate a template without rendering and report the clips and fields compose_video will require; optionally return the resolved descriptor for given fields and the timeline (sections, motion events, beats, cues).

tools.name: compose_video
tools.description: Render a template to an MP4 with FFmpeg and return the output path.

tools.name: render_frames
tools.description: Render a native template and return still frames as PNG images: chosen moments, cuts, contact sheets, safe zones, comparisons.

tools.name: probe_media
tools.description: Inspect a local media file and report stream codecs, duration, audio sample rate and size.

tools.name: extract_style
tools.description: Derive a global.theme and a style guide from a reference image or clip: palette roles with WCAG contrast, texture, pacing and motion energy.

tools.name: analyze_music
tools.description: Measure a local music file: tempo, beat grid, confidence and drop/build/end cues for global.beats.

tools.name: analyze_sound
tools.description: Render a composed or preset sfx sound with the engine synth: length, levels, centroid, attack, advisories, spectrogram and waveform PNGs.

tools.name: transcribe_media
tools.description: Transcribe the speech of a local audio/video file with whisper.cpp on this machine: word timings, SRT, language and confidence to pin into subtitles.words.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Report what the local FFmpeg really renders (drawtext, LUTs, transitions, loudness, encoders), each with a fix.

tools.name: open_in_builder
tools.description: Return a link that opens the template in the LeClap web builder; the template travels in the URL fragment, never uploaded.

tools.name: render_remotion_clip
tools.description: Render a composition from your own Remotion project to an MP4. Gated — see notes.

tools.name: get_effect_schema
tools.description: Discover a registered JSON effect, its strict props and assets, output metadata, and runtime requirements.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Preview frames or a short frame range of a registered JSON effect using trusted local Remotion source.

tools.name: edit_template
tools.description: Apply a JSON Patch (RFC 6902) and registered effect-prop edits to inline template JSON atomically using an expected revision; the result must validate.

dev.leclap.video.notes: Fourteen tools are always registered. get_effect_schema, render_preview and render_remotion_clip require the Remotion opt-in. Registered JSON effects use operator-configured trusted source and require a configured backend for validation, editing and rendering; callers cannot select executable source through effect JSON. edit_template, including its effect-prop edits, remains registered when Remotion is disabled.
